snippet.title: SIMPLE1500シリーズ Vol.63 THE ガンシューティング2. [PlayStation - AMS Co. Ltd., D3Publisher Inc.]. 2001. ALL.
snippet.description:
.The Gun Shooting 2. - AMS.
.Played By PiE. - "November 21st, 2022".
.
.Mobygame.comi. - "Aim and shoot! Shoot it quick! Rapid-fire! This title includes 30 stages packed with shooting fun!
From “Shoot the gifts”, “Blow the coins” etc to games that cannot be played in conventional gun shooting games such as “Goldfish scooping” , a huge variety of games are available.
Everyone will enjoy the four types of game modes in this game."
.
